List rules in priority order, lowest first

## Usage

```text
chainmail rule list [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail rule list
chainmail rule list --account gmail --disabled
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string   only rules that cover this account, by name or by covering every account
      --deleted          only deleted rules
      --disabled         only disabled rules
      --enabled          only enabled rules
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
